$ books --help
--- stdout
usage: books [-h] {pl,income,expenses,setaside,export,add,doctor} ...

books — Taylor's own books, from where the numbers actually live
(plans/03-books.md, ROADMAP B3; the record is private-docs/TAXES.md).

  books                         # this month's P&L
  books pl [--year Y|--month Y-M]        gross, fees, refunds, net income, cash expenses, net profit
  books pl --json [--month Y-M]          Stripe only, integer cents, one object (B102: the owner's overview)
  books income [--year|--month] [--all]  every Stripe balance transaction that is money in (or out), per account
  books expenses [--year|--month]        real spend: API keys, Gemini, Resend, manual rows; the statement-only vendors
  books setaside [--year|--month]        25-30% of net profit, the rule in TAXES.md §4
  books export [--year] [--out DIR]      income-Y.csv, expenses-Y.csv, pl-Y.csv (default private-docs/exports/)
  books add income|expense DATE VENDOR AMOUNT ["note"]   a cash row Stripe/the ledgers don't have; also logged in TAXES.md
  books doctor

Income is Stripe: every STRIPE_KEY_* in the toolbelt is one account (PATCHLAMP,
PLATEFUL). Balance transactions carry gross, fee and net per payment, so the
books show gross with Stripe's fee as an expense — the way the 1099-K is
filed. Expenses are the relay ledger's cash rows (billed_to != plan; the
plan rows are notional and are shown on their own line, never deducted), the
toolbelt ledger (images, video, newsletter), and manual rows in
private-docs/books.jsonl. Vendors with no local record (TAXES.md §3) are
listed as statement-only reminders. Nothing here prints a key.

Config, by name, never printed:  STRIPE_KEY_<ACCOUNT>   ~/.config/claude-tools/env

positional arguments:
  {pl,income,expenses,setaside,export,add,doctor}
    pl                  the P&L
    income              Stripe money in/out
    expenses            real spend
    setaside            what to put away
    export              CSVs for the CPA
    add                 a cash row with no other record

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
--- stderr
--- exit 0
